text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paginated alert: edge-gateway error-rate spike detected (502/504) on edge3-eu-west, 5m error rate ~12%
sara: saw the page, jumping in. which routes are the worst?
mike: oncall here. `/v1/generate` and some embedding routes. customer-facing failures reported.
toni: traced to upstream resets in the mux layer. logs show a lot of `upstream reset` and `connection refused` from edge3 pool.
sara: impact: ~10-15% of requests failing for a subset of customers behind edge3. no auth or quota anomalies.
mike: quick checks: `kubectl logs apigw-edge3 --since=5m | grep -E "502|504" | wc -l` -> 182 errors in last 5m
devon: config push ready. suggest temporary hard cap on connections and quick traffic shift to edge1 while we scrub.
toni: also seeing increased kvcache evictions on inference nodes backing edge3, could be cascading timeouts.
sara: incident-bot, pin runbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/edge-502 (for handoffs + checklist)
incident-bot: runbook pinned by sara
mike: mitigation plan (fast): 1) apply apigw connection cap on edge3 (1000->200) 2) shift 20% traffic to edge1 3) monitor 10m 4) if >5% errors, remove edge3 from LB
devon: applying config now: 
```
sed -e 's/max_conns: 1000/max_conns: 200/' /etc/apigw/config.yaml | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl rollout status deploy/apigw-edge3 --watch
```
devon: traffic-shift command ready for infra LB: `trafficctl shift --from edge3 --to edge1 --percent 20`
toni: enabling kvcache read-only fallback for edge3 inference pool to avoid KV thrash
sara: is there any large customer in the affected subset we should call?
customer-support: collecting top 5 affected accounts now, will open tickets and notify AMs
mike: monitoring: error rate dipped to ~7% after cap + shift. still not fully healthy but trending in right direction
incident-bot: severity still P1 — auto-escalation in 15m if errors >5%
devon: if things regress we can do a fast rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/apigw-edge3` (takes ~30s to start reverting)
toni: executing kvcache fallback, will report back in 2m
sara: please snapshot apigw and mux metrics for postmortem (mint link: dashboards/edge3/last-30m)
mike: noted. assigning postmortem owner: mike. handoff to toni for next 4h. toni, you're primary for follow-ups + RCA
toni: acknowledged, taking over. will post updates every 10m and escalate if error rate >5%
customer-support: top customers notified via email thread; we included workaround to retry with exponential backoff
incident-bot: alert update: error rate now 4.9% (5m) :white_check_mark: — monitoring continues
sara: great work. keep this channel for live updates, and please avoid broad config changes beyond the plan.
mike: thanks everyone — keeping channel open until fully stable :thumbsup:
